context: Academic case scenarios; monetary results are AUD labour-cost equivalents, not realised savings.

reference_cohort.classification: 160 arrivals is case evidence; one request per part and mutually exclusive route denominators are analysis assumptions; shelf-miss frequency is unknown.

recording_minutes.classification: The 30-minute audit activity is interpreted per record; an alternative daily interpretation remains possible. TO-BE verification times are proposed inputs.

repair.classification: Failure rates and repair times originate in the case; Senior repetition scope is an interpretation sensitivity; review/capture time and reuse shares are proposed inputs.

inventory.classification: Daily control interpretation and selected recovery work are assumptions. R4/R5 combine controls and cohort exceptions only in a hypothetical steady-state day; scan volumes/times and reducible share are trial inputs.
